name: opcua-mcp
description: OPC UA Part 4 services and typed industrial companion tools, including Robotics, Vision, AMB, Machinery, Scales, Pumps, Device Integration, ISA-95 and Positioning. Select bounded, composable catalogs with --profile; use --help for the current names. The default 'full' profile includes every catalog. Explicit controls preserve server permissions and refusals; companion file transfers require a host-configured root.
